<cite ref="Sotah 8b:5">Sot. 8ᵇ</cite> (proverbial expression) <he>ש׳ ערטילאי וכ׳</he> undressed, naked, but with shoes on (a person cares more for shoes than for any other article of dress); <cite ref="Ketubot 65b:1">Keth. 65ᵇ</cite> top <he>האי תנא ש׳ וכ׳</he> this Tannai (who gave the wife the right to ask for three pairs of shoes and one suit of clothes) seems to assume that a woman cares more for shoes &c.
